[{"address":"ms::p6::p6_conv_6","content":"{\"full_source_conversation\":\"supporter: Hi Jane, it's great to hear from you again. How have you been holding up?\\nseeker: Hi, it's been a bit rough lately. My car broke down and the repair costs are just... more than I can handle right now.\\nsupporter: Oh no, I'm so sorry to hear that, Jane. That must be incredibly stressful, especially with everything else you've had to deal with recently.\\nseeker: It really is. I've been trying to manage, but the financial stress keeps piling up. I still haven't resolved the money issue with my friend, and now this... It's overwhelming.\\nsupporter: I can only imagine how difficult that must be. You've been doing your best under such challenging circumstances. It's okay to feel overwhelmed.\\nseeker: Thank you. Sometimes it feels like I'm just not able to catch a break. I've been trying to keep track of everything with my journal, but it feels like every day brings something new.\\nsupporter: Journaling is a great tool, and it's a good step that you're using it to process your thoughts and feelings. It shows how you're trying to find ways to cope.\\nseeker: Yeah, I thought it might help calm my anxieties. But with my job performance not being where it's supposed to be, and money problems, I just feel stuck.\\nsupporter: Feeling stuck is definitely tough. It's important to remember that it's not a reflection of your abilities or worth. You're dealing with a lot, and your efforts are meaningful.\\nseeker: Thanks. Sometimes I just worry that I'm not living up to expectations, especially at work. The fear of being seen as incompetent is always there.\\nsupporter: I understand. Work pressure can be intense, and when combined with personal challenges, it's a lot to balance. Have you been able to talk to anyone at work about how you're feeling?\\nseeker: Not yet. I'm hesitant because I don't want it to seem like I'm making excuses. I really want to prove myself and get back on track.\\nsupporter: That makes sense. It might help to reach out for support when you're ready, even just to get some feedback. Sometimes, opening up can bring understanding and solutions you couldn't see before.\\nseeker: You're right. I'll think about that. Maybe just having a conversation could help put things into perspective.\\nsupporter: Absolutely, even small steps can lead to positive changes. Remember, you're doing the best you can, and it's okay to seek help when you need it.\\nseeker: I will try to remember that. It's helpful to talk about it and just get it off my chest a bit.\\nsupporter: I'm glad you reached out, Jane. It's important to have a space where you feel heard. If you ever need to talk or get things off your mind, I'm here.\\nseeker: Thank you so much. It really means a lot to have someone who listens and understands.\\nsupporter: You're welcome. Remember, one step at a time, and be gentle with yourself. You're not alone in this, and there are brighter days ahead.\\nseeker: I'll keep that in mind. Thanks again for your support.\",\"kind\":\"MS\",\"reported_at\":\"2024-12-10\",\"schema\":\"pm-rl1-attributed-evidence-v2\",\"speaker_scope\":\"Historical seeker and supporter; neither role supplies an AI biography.\"}","head":"MS","reported_at":"2024-12-10"}]
</resources>
It’s just a combination of things. The pressure at work never seems to end, and after the performance review last November, I’ve been second-guessing myself a lot.
